subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Which status sections may be exposed in shared-agent contexts, and should one agent-aware section policy replace the proposed whole-card boolean and competing config scopes?
rationale: The missing capability is proven, but maintainers must define the least-disclosure boundary, output behavior, and single configuration owner before implementation.

options.title: Section-level least disclosure
options.body: Add one agent-aware allowlist or suppression policy shared by `/status` and `session_status`, with current output as the default.

options.title: Whole-card opt-out
options.body: Add one boolean that suppresses rendered status text while retaining structured tool details where applicable.

options.title: Keep authorized output
options.body: Reject new configuration and rely on command authorization plus session visibility as the disclosure boundary.

recommendation.title: Section-level least disclosure
recommendation.body: Add one agent-aware allowlist or suppression policy shared by `/status` and `session_status`, with current output as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: The original tool authorship, continuing status-path work, and participation in this issue make steipete the strongest available decision owner.
